analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· Position relative to SMA100 (KRW 115,915) / SMA200 (KRW 95,338): mid-to-long term trend strength at neutral level
· 52-week position (59.2%) + current price level is 28.5% below 52-week high

· RSI trajectory (52.1→52.7): neutral zone continuation confirmed
· MACD histogram trajectory (754.2302→30.9417): improving trend, bullish expansion signal

[Support & Resistance]

· Swing Resistance (KRW 110,910): potential for further upside upon breaking resistance

[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.78x): subdued volume, moderate confidence in price action
· Current phase diagnosis: strengthening uptrend within accumulation phase, buy entry condition met upon breaking KRW 110,910
